notes.decision: Translated 'depart' — Lyc ⲟⲩⲱⲗ 'go away, depart' parallels the preceding ⲟⲩⲓ̈ⲛⲉ 'pass' as a synonymous verb of removal. The pair ('does not pass forever, neither does it depart') describes the Land of Light's permanence.

Translated 'The twelfth: that you should also set down' — taking ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍⲙⲛⲧⲥⲛⲁⲩⲥ as ordinal 'the twelfth' (cf. accumulated vocab ⲡⲙⲁⲍⲙⲛⲧⲥⲛⲁⲩⲥ); ⲉⲕⲁⲟⲛ as ⲉ-ⲕⲁ-ⲟⲛ 'that you place/set still' (2sg with ⲕⲱ + ⲟⲛ 'again, still'). The verbal sense is uncertain.
Translated 'the Half-region' per accumulated vocabulary; the Half designates the cosmic region whose works are hidden from the Aeons of Light.
Translated 'they were banished out' — ⲥⲁⲍⲣ = Lyc ⲥⲱϩⲣ̄ 'drive away, banish' + ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth.' Captures the spatial expulsion of the Mighty Ones from the firmaments to the earth.

Translated 'yet not from the earth alone' — taking ⲭⲛ̄ as adversative 'but, yet' (parallel to ϫⲛ̄ in Sahidic). The structure contrasts banishment from the firmaments-to-earth with banishment from yet a higher region (the honor).

Translated 'the one of the Mother, the one of the Darkness, with the one of the Fire' — taking the parallel structure ⲡⲁ + def article + noun across all three. ⲡⲁⲧⲙⲁⲩ = ⲡⲁ-ⲧⲙⲁⲩ 'the one of the Mother' (paralleling the relational pattern). Alternative reading 'motherless' (privative ⲁⲧ-) is grammatically possible but breaks parallelism with the other two epithets.

Translated 'eat upon a single way' — taking ⲁⲛⲟⲩⲍⲓⲧ as ⲁ-ⲛ-ⲟⲩ-ⲍⲓⲧ 'at/upon a way' (ⲍⲓⲧ = ⲍⲓⲏ 'way, road,' cf. line 33 ⲡϣⲁⲙⲧ ⲛ̄ⲍⲓⲓ̈ⲧ 'three roads'). The dichotomy is then 'one way upon the firmament' vs 'the first earth.' Alternative: 'in one (place)' from ⲟⲩⲱⲧ 'single.'
Translated 'he cast them' — Lyc form of ⲛⲟⲩϫⲉ 'throw, cast' with 3pl object suffix. Continues the spatial expulsion sequence.

Translated 'was about to pour out' — taking ⲛⲟⲩⲉ as either a near-future auxiliary (related to ⲛⲟⲩ 'approach') or a desiderative (related to ⲟⲩⲱϣ 'wish'). The construction 'was about to / wished to pour forth' fits the narrative sequence.
Translated 'each one to his place' — ⲛⲉⲉ tentatively read as 'place' or 'measure' parallel to ⲡⲉϥⲕⲁⲓⲣⲟⲥ 'his appointed time' in line 30. Could alternatively be 'his portion' or 'his measure-marker.'
Translated 'he drew them out, he cast them out' — ⲡⲁⲛⲕ from ⲡⲱⲛⲕ 'draw out, scoop'; ⲭⲁⲗⲍ tentatively from a removal/extraction verb. Both with ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth' confirm directional expulsion.

Translated 'that of the Mother' — parallel to ⲧⲁⲡⲧⲏⲩ 'of the wind' and ⲧⲁⲧⲥⲉⲧⲉ 'of the fire.' The standard Manichaean three garments of the Living Spirit are wind/fire/water; ⲡⲙⲁⲩ here is read as 'the Mother' (cosmic principle), though semantic overlap with water is possible in this register.
Translated 'he cast them down' — Lyc ⲡⲁⲍⲧ from ⲡⲁϩⲧ̄ 'pour out, cast down, prostrate.' Maintains the downward-cast semantics consistent with ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ 'downward' in line 30.

Translated 'the three roads' — ⲍⲓⲓ̈ⲧ as Lyc plural of ϩⲓⲏ 'way, road.' Likely refers to the three paths of the Judge of Truth (death, life, reconciliation) per accumulated vocabulary on ⲡⲕⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥ ⲛⲧⲉ ⲧⲙⲏⲉ.
